items.description: Collective decision: travel by chartered coach, door to door, there and back, instead of the train.
items.notes: Proposed by Farida at turn 3, supported by Odile and accepted by Yannick.

items.description: Yannick's train proposal (140 euros cheaper, two connections) was rejected for safety reasons.
items.notes: Rejected proposal. Reporting it as dropped inside the adopted decision (E1) is acceptable; reporting the train as adopted is not.

items.description: Yannick books the chartered coach with the usual company, calling tomorrow to lock in the date; asked by Odile and accepted by Yannick.
Farida asks two insurers for cancellation insurance quotes; Farida later withdrew this because the centre's package already includes the insurance.
items.notes: Original statement at turn 8; change at turn 18, 10 turns later.

items.description: Odile hands out the parental consent forms on Monday and collects them signed before November 20.
items.notes: Monday is the hand-out day; November 20 is the deadline for the signed forms.

items.description: Subsidy application to the county council for families who cannot afford 180 euros: left to Mrs Garnier, the bursar, who is absent; no participant owns it.
Presenting at the parents' information meeting has no owner: Farida quoted a remark by Yannick, who said it was a joke and declined.
items.notes: The first-person promise at turn 12 is Farida quoting Yannick, who never commits.

items.description: Booklet for the peat bog workshop: Farida could possibly prepare it, provided her class councils are finished in time.
items.notes: Odile's 'that would be nice' does not turn the conditional offer into a commitment.

items.description: List of pupils with allergies or medication, requested by the centre: an unidentified voice promised to forward it tonight, so the owner cannot be confirmed.

forbidden.description: No task owned by Yannick for the parents' meeting: the promise was quoted by Farida and Yannick declined.
No task owned by Farida for the parents' meeting: quoting someone is not committing.
The workshop booklet is not a firm task for Farida.
No task for the subsidy application: it is left to Mrs Garnier, who is absent.
No task, for anyone, to forward the allergy list: the promising voice is unidentified.
The coach booking is not Odile's task: she asked, Yannick accepted.

forbidden_claims: Yannick presents the parents' information meeting.
Farida has committed to preparing the peat bog booklet.
Farida is still collecting cancellation insurance quotes.
A participant files the subsidy application.
Yannick, Farida or Odile forwards the allergy list tonight.
Kayaking is part of the programme.
A calendar date (day number) is given for Yannick's call 'tomorrow', Odile's Monday hand-out or the voice's 'tonight'.
detail_checks: Two seventh-grade classes: fifty-two pupils and six chaperones, three days in December at the Combe Noire centre.
The train would be 140 euros cheaper but involves two connections.
The trip costs 180 euros per pupil.
Cancellation insurance is already included in the centre's package.
Activities: snowshoe hiking and a cheese dairy visit; kayaking is closed in December; the centre provides all snowshoe equipment.
